meta.parties: Suppramaniam Chetty v. Jayawardene Et Al

rules.statement: The Court held that the mortgage decree effectively ordered the sale of lot (1g) as it was included in lots (1a) and (1b), which were sold under the mortgage.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think it must be held that since lots (1a) and (1 b) cover lot (1 g), the mortgage decree in effect ordered the sale of lot (1 g)."
